primary_metric: per-bet mean pip of fading the pre-fix drift over sessions with |pre_z|>=1.0, session cluster-robust SE + block-bootstrap CI
result_summary: REJECTED on arm 4, inverted. Arms 1-3 PASS cleanly (fade pays +0.905 t2.48 / +1.552 t3.54; beats 100% of 21 placebo hours both; month-end 4x on 6B +5.05 t3.08). Arm 4 FAILS inverted: entire effect is POST-2015-02-15 (6E -0.00 vs +1.36; 6B -0.11 vs +2.41). Diagnosed: entry open(f+2)=16:02 London is INSIDE the post-2015 5-min fix window (closes 16:02:30). Entry at f+3 kills it on both; 1-minute hold captures the whole 30-min result at higher t. This measures price impact reverting INSIDE the benchmark averaging window, not a post-fix reversal. Not tradable at any honest entry.
